svg.desc: Two panels of beliefs over rounds 0 to 30 under repeated averaging on a star: a hub who listens equally to herself and five outer people, each of whom listens equally to herself and the hub. The starting beliefs are 1 for the hub and −1, −0.5, 0, 0.5, 0 for the outer people; the simple average of all six is 0. Top, everyone converges to 0.25, a dashed line, with influence weights 0.375 for the hub and 0.125 for each outer person; the dotted line marks the simple average; every belief is within 0.01 of the consensus from round 7; the effective number of independent sources is 4.57. Bottom, the outer person who started at −1 puts 0.9 on herself and 0.1 on the hub: everyone converges to −0.167, with weights 0.417 for her, 0.25 for the hub and 0.083 for each other outer person; within 0.01 from round 26; effective number of sources 3.79.
